questions.text: Calculate the change in collector current with a change in neutral base width, and estimate the Early voltage.

The metallurgical base width of a silicon npn bipolar transistor is x_{B} = 0.80 \, \mu m. The base and collector doping concentrations are N_{E} = 5 \times 10^{16} \, cm^{-3} and N_{C} = 2 \times 10^{15} \, cm^{-3}, respectively. (a) Determine the punch-through voltage. (b) What is the expected avalanche breakdown voltage?
